targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "motor_rpm")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "motor_temp_c")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "line_speed_upm")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "flow_rate_m3h")

from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r.message_type == "PROC" and (r._field == "sensor_status" or r._field == "temperature_c" or r._field == "pressure_bar")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device_id", "sensor_status", "temperature_c", "pressure_bar"])
